**Environment-Based Design (EBD)** is a design methodology developed by **Yong Zeng**. Its central idea is that design changes an existing environment into a desired one by creating a new artefact. EBD’s three main activities are **environment analysis**, **conflict identification**, and **solution generation**.

### Four facts

1. **EBD is a design methodology developed by Yong Zeng over roughly two decades.** It stems from the observation that design aims to change an existing environment into a desired one by generating a new artefact; design starts from the environment, functions for the environment, and brings changes to the environment.  
   Source: [ASME — Environment-Based Design (EBD)](https://asmedigitalcollection.asme.org/IDETC-CIE/proceedings-abstract/IDETC-CIE2011/54860/237/354151)
